summary: An unbounded memo cache makes a long-running worker's memory climb until it crashes; only the process table and worker log show it.
prompt: The ingest worker spends most of its time in `geocode`. Memoize `geocode(address)` in src/geocode.js so that repeated addresses are not recomputed; the result for an address never changes. Add a test.
environment: An ingest worker (worker/ingest.js, supervised by service/dev.js; its output goes to logs/ingest.log) runs in the background, restarts when src/ changes, and geocodes a continuous stream of incoming records.
